title: TWITTER Gravel V3 carbon frameset instruction-manual mirror
notes: Independent exact-model mirror, not a TWITTER-owned publication. It identifies the matching 45 / 48 / 51 / 54 Gravel V3 press-fit frame, publishes a 700x40C maximum, approximately 1.25 kg frame and 0.49 kg fork, and provides the four-size geometry table. Its BB86 label agrees with one part of the retained 2024 seller material but conflicts with that seller table's BB92 wording, so the bottom-bracket conflict remains explicit.
